flow.description: BFF receives structured LLM result with template_id, data payload and optional action_key.
BFF verifies template_id exists in templates/registry.json and template HTML exists under templates/html.
BFF verifies every action_key and followup action_key exists in platform/action-map.json.
BFF renders registered HTML template, fills data bindings and appends answer followup suggestions.
When user clicks a suggestion, BFF sends the suggestion prompt back to LLM or executes the registered action target.
